notes: Cleans confidential Statistics Norway individual tax registers (skatt.selvh2005, skatt.selvh2006, reached via libname skatt '/data') and exports the stacked panel to Stata. Substituted 5-row inline selvh2005 / selvh2006 samples with the same columns for the two external libnames; the RENAME-on-SET normalization (bel3110 -> bel3114 so the two vintages share a column name), the per-year aar= tag, the vertical SET stacking, and the PROC EXPORT DBMS=STATA call are unchanged from upstream. Added PROC PRINT / PROC MEANS at the end purely to exercise the resulting panel for this bundle (not present in the original, which ends at PROC EXPORT).
